Privacy Policy

Last Updated: June 26, 2026
Effective Date: June 26, 2026

Precision Metronome (hereinafter referred to as “this App”) is developed and provided by Beihai Yidian Network Technology Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as “we” or “us”). This App is a purely offline standalone tool that does not require network access and does not actively collect, store, or transmit any of your personal information.

1. How We Collect and Use Your Personal Information

This App does not collect your personal information in any way, including but not limited to:

  • Does not read your device’s unique identifiers (such as IMEI/Android ID/IDFA);
  • Does not access your contacts, photo library, calendar, location, microphone, or camera;
  • Does not use any network permissions and does not upload any data to any server;
  • Does not integrate any third-party SDKs (such as analytics, advertising, or push notification services).

Since this App does not request any system permissions, you will not receive any permission pop-up requests during initial installation or usage.

2. Data Storage and Security

All data generated by this App (such as your input content, preferences, and settings) is stored solely on your local device and is managed by you. Upon uninstallation of this App, all related local data will be cleared and cannot be recovered or accessed by us.

3. Children’s Privacy

This App does not collect personal information from users of any age group. Children may use this App with confidence.

4. Your Rights

Since this App does not collect any of your personal information, there is no need for you to access, correct, or delete such data. If you uninstall this App, all locally stored data will be removed automatically.

5. Policy Updates

If we make material changes to this Privacy Policy in the future (e.g., adding new features that require permissions), we will post a prominent update notice within this App and re-obtain your consent.
